summary.en: Adds first-class Dokploy deployment support, dedicated two-factor encryption configuration, and global browser Push-to-Talk integration improvements.

description.en: A dedicated Compose deployment, self-contained import package, generated template payload, and operator documentation simplify deployments with Dokploy's native domain management.
Windows browser users can opt in to the local PTT helper from voice settings, with persistent enablement, status feedback, and lifecycle-aware connection handling.
AUTH_2FA_SECRET_KEY enables a stable, separate key for encrypting stored two-factor secrets while retaining the JWT_SECRET fallback for existing deployments.

en: Back up PostgreSQL and both Garage volumes and test a restore before updating.
Redeploy backend and frontend from the shared v0.4.0 release tag without removing persistent volumes.
For Dokploy, use docker-compose.dokploy.yml or the packaged template, replace generated domains and secrets, and set NEBULYNK_SOURCE_REF to v0.4.0 when a tag-pinned deployment is required.
Keep AUTH_2FA_SECRET_KEY unchanged when it is already configured; existing installations may leave it unset and use the JWT_SECRET fallback.
